names.name: Googlebot
names.note: Main Search crawler (smartphone and desktop UAs carry 'Googlebot/2.1'). It is a prefix of Googlebot-Image, Googlebot-Video and Googlebot-IA, so test the longer tokens first if the sub-type matters. Other bots mention it ('FreshRSS/1.11.2 ... like Googlebot', 'Fake-Googlebot' in seo4ajax), so test non-Google tokens before this one.

names.name: Googlebot-Image
names.note: Google Images, Discover and image search features. UA 'Googlebot-Image/1.0'.

names.name: Googlebot-Video
names.note: Video search features. UA 'Googlebot-Video/1.0'.

names.name: Googlebot-News
names.note: robots.txt token only. Google documents no UA of its own: it crawls with the regular Googlebot UAs, so this string never appears in real traffic.

names.name: Storebot-Google
names.note: Google Shopping surfaces. Desktop and mobile UAs carry 'Storebot-Google/1.0'. Radar files it under SEO.

names.name: Google-InspectionTool
names.note: Search Console URL Inspection and Rich Results Test. Google says it has no effect on Search itself; Radar files it under security. Kept here because it renders pages as Search does.

names.name: Googlebot-Mobile
names.note: Retired feature-phone crawler. Already covered by the Googlebot substring; listed for completeness.

names.name: Googlebot-IA
names.note: Radar labels it Google Scholar ('Googlebot-IA/2.1'). Not in Google's crawler documentation, so unverified. Covered by the Googlebot substring.

names.name: bingbot
names.note: All Bingbot UAs carry 'bingbot/2.0'. Match 'bingbot/' with the slash, or test adidxbot first: AdIdxBot's UA ends in '+http://www.bing.com/bingbot.htm', which contains 'bingbot'. Bing states that BingPreview now also sends bingbot UAs, so previews are indistinguishable from indexing.

names.name: msnbot
names.note: Legacy MSN Search crawler (msnbot/, msnbot-media/, 'MSNBot/Nutch'). Radar still lists it. An old AdIdxBot UA, 'adidxbot/1.1 (+http://search.msn.com/msnbot.htm)', contains it, so test adidxbot first.

names.name: Applebot
names.note: Spotlight, Siri and Safari search. Applebot-Extended is a robots.txt control token that never crawls and has no UA, so this substring has no real collision. Radar files Applebot under AI_SEARCH.

names.name: DuckDuckBot
names.note: Covers 'DuckDuckBot/1.1' and 'DuckDuckBot-Https/1.1'. DuckAssistBot (AI) does not contain this token.

names.name: DuckDuckGo-Favicons-Bot
names.note: Favicon fetcher for result pages. Do not use bare 'duckduckgo': the DuckDuckGo browser UA contains 'DuckDuckGo/5'.

names.name: YandexBot
names.note: Main indexing robot, including the 'YandexBot/3.0; MirrorDetector' variant. Do not use bare 'yandex': Yandex Browser and the Yandex app contain 'YaBrowser' and 'YaSearchBrowser', and isbot only matches '^yandex'.

names.name: YandexImages
names.note: Yandex Images indexing.

names.name: YandexVideo
names.note: Video search indexing. Prefix of YandexVideoParser.

names.name: YandexVideoParser
names.note: Video search indexing; ignores general robots.txt rules.

names.name: YandexMedia
names.note: Multimedia indexing.

names.name: YandexMobileBot
names.note: Checks mobile-friendly layouts; iPhone-style UA with '(compatible; YandexMobileBot/3.0; ...)'.

names.name: YandexRenderResourcesBot
names.note: Loads JS and CSS for rendering pages the main crawler may index.

names.name: YandexComBot
names.note: Indexes non-Russian-language content; URL is ya.cc/bots, so the 'yandex.com/bots' catch-all misses it.

names.name: YandexFavicons
names.note: Favicons for search results.

names.name: YandexBlogs
names.note: Blog search, including post comments.

names.name: YandexImageResizer
names.note: Image robot for mobile surfaces.

names.name: YandexOntoDB
names.note: Information-card (knowledge panel) robot. Prefix of YandexOntoDBAPI.

names.name: YandexVertis
names.note: Search verticals robot.

names.name: YandexVerticals
names.note: Classifieds verticals (Auto.ru, Realty, Jobs, Reviews).

names.name: YandexMarket
names.note: Yandex Market product search.

names.name: YandexSearchShop
names.note: Downloads YML product catalogs on user request.

names.name: YandexSpravBot
names.note: Yandex Business directory robot.

names.name: YandexSitelinks
names.note: Checks sitelink availability ('YandexSitelinks; Dyatel').

names.name: Baiduspider
names.note: Covers Baiduspider-image, -video, -news, -favo, -render and the mobile variants. Baiduspider-ads and Baiduspider-cpro (advertising) also contain it, so test those first if ads must be separate. Baidu's spider help page now redirects to a FAQ index without UA details. Do not use bare 'baidu': the Baidu app contains 'baiduboxapp'.

names.name: Sogou web spider
names.note: Main crawler ('Sogou web spider/4.0(+http://www.sogou.com/docs/help/webmasters.htm#07)'). Match all Sogou crawlers with /sogou[\w -]*spider/i; bare 'sogou' also matches Sogou's mobile browser ('SogouMobileBrowser', 'SogouMSE'). Sogou's help page confirms robots.txt support but not the UA strings.

names.name: Sogou inst spider
names.note: Sogou instant-index crawler.

names.name: Sogou Pic Spider
names.note: Image crawler.

names.name: Sogou News Spider
names.note: News crawler.

names.name: Sogou Orion spider
names.note: Sogou crawler variant.

names.name: Sogou head spider
names.note: HEAD-request crawler.

names.name: Sogou-Test-Spider
names.note: Test crawler with an old MSIE-style UA.

names.name: 360Spider
names.note: Web search; the same page lists 360Spider-Image and 360Spider-Video, which this token covers. Do not use bare '360': the 360 browser carries '360SE' or 'QIHU 360'.

names.name: HaosouSpider
names.note: Legacy name from the Haosou rebrand, seen inside 360Spider UAs.

names.name: YisouSpider
names.note: Shenma mobile search. Official documentation could not be reached; UA strings come from monperrus.

names.name: ToutiaoSpider
names.note: Toutiao search. Radar identifies Toutiao by the URL 'zhanzhang.toutiao.com'. Bytespider is ByteDance's AI crawler and belongs to the AI list.

names.name: Yeti
names.note: UA 'Mozilla/5.0 (compatible; Yeti/1.1; +https://naver.me/spd)'. Match 'yeti/' rather than the bare word. Never use bare 'naver': the NAVER app UA contains 'NAVER(inapp; search; ...)'. Naver's own help could not be fetched.

names.name: NaverBot
names.note: Legacy Naver crawler.

names.name: Daum
names.note: UA 'Mozilla/5.0 (compatible; Daum/4.1; +http://cs.daum.net/faq/15/4118.html?faqId=28966)'. Match with a preceding space or '; ' as isbot does (' daum[ /]') so the Daum app's 'DaumApps/' token does not match. An older form is '(compatible; MSIE or Firefox mutant;) Daum 4.1' with a space, which 'Daum/' misses. Daum's FAQ only documents the robots.txt token 'DAUM'.

names.name: Daumoa
names.note: Legacy Daum crawler name.

names.name: ZumBot
names.note: Korean search (help.zum.com).

names.name: SeznamBot
names.note: UA 'Mozilla/5.0 (compatible; SeznamBot/4.0; +https://o-seznam.cz/...)'. The Seznam browser uses 'SznProhlizec' and does not match.

names.name: SeznamHomepageCrawler
names.note: Homepage crawler.

names.name: Seznam-Zbozi-robot
names.note: Zbozi.cz product search.

names.name: Qwantbot
names.note: Format 'Qwantbot{-news}/X.Y_{worker}'; covers Qwantbot-news. The help page refused direct fetching (403); format confirmed through search results quoting it.

names.name: Qwantify
names.note: Legacy Qwant crawler name.

names.name: MojeekBot
names.note: Mojeek's own index.

names.name: coccocbot
names.note: Covers coccocbot-web, -image, -fast and -shopping. coccocbot-ads is advertising and also contains this token, so test it first. The Coc Coc browser uses 'coc_coc_browser' and does not match.

names.name: PetalBot
names.note: Petal Search index and Huawei Assistant recommendations. Radar files it under AI_CRAWLER, so expect overlap with the AI list.

names.name: AspiegelBot
names.note: Predecessor of PetalBot.

names.name: Slurp
names.note: 'Mozilla/5.0 (compatible; Yahoo! Slurp; http://help.yahoo.com/help/us/ysearch/slurp)'. Yahoo web results come from Bing, so Slurp is mostly legacy. isbot deliberately leaves the bare 'Mozilla/5.0 (compatible; Yahoo! Slurp)' (no URL) unflagged.

names.name: Y!J-BRW
names.note: One of five Yahoo! JAPAN crawlers (BRU/VSIDX, BRW, ASR, MMP/dscv, WSC) used for search, research and development. The page warns they may appear without '!' as 'YJ-xxx', so match /y!?j-(?:bru|brw|asr|mmp|wsc)/i. Radar files these under advertising, which disagrees with the official page.

names.name: Y!J-BRU
names.note: Seen as 'Y!J-BRU/VSIDX'. See Y!J-BRW.

names.name: Y!J-ASR
names.note: See Y!J-BRW.

names.name: Y!J-MMP
names.note: Seen as 'Y!J-MMP/dscv'. See Y!J-BRW.

names.name: Y!J-WSC
names.note: See Y!J-BRW.

names.name: ichiro
names.note: Legacy goo crawler ('ichiro/mobile goo'). goo search results come from Google. Never use bare 'goo'.

names.name: Exabot
names.note: Legacy; Exalead's public web search is closed. 'exabot' is also a substring of 'Alexabot', so match /\bexabot/i.

names.name: Bravebot
names.note: Radar lists a verified 'Bravebot' pattern (AI_SEARCH), but Brave's own help page says its crawler 'does not advertise a differentiated user agent'. Treat as uncertain.

names.name: Kagibot
names.note: UA 'Mozilla/5.0 (compatible; Kagibot/1.0; +https://kagi.com/bot)'. kagi-fetcher (AI) does not contain this token.

names.name: search.marginalia.nu
names.note: The whole UA is this string; it contains no 'bot' word, so generic patterns miss it.

names.name: Swisscows Favicons
names.note: Favicon fetcher for results (added to monperrus in 2026 from DataDome). No Swisscows indexing crawler UA was found.

names.name: Mail.RU_Bot
names.note: Covers 'Mail.RU_Bot/2.0' and '/Fast/'. Radar files it under PAGE_PREVIEW.

names.name: Seekport
names.note: Covers 'SeekportBot' and the older 'Seekport Crawler'.

names.name: Linespider

names.name: Owler

names.name: StractBot

names.name: Diffbot

names.name: Dola-SearchBot

names.name: HenkBot
